core_style.default_register: casual — often uses colloquial expressions and informal language
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — frequently combines multiple clauses in a single sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond in conversations, often jumping between thoughts
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more serious tone when discussing danger or emotional topics, contrasting with his usual lightheartedness

humor.frequency: occasional — often appears when he feels insecure or outmatched
humor.mechanism: understatement — downplays his own abilities or situation to elicit humor

structural_patterns: uses rhetorical questions to express disbelief
speech_signature.naming_behavior: uses nicknames for friends, indicating familiarity and camaraderie, but rarely renames authority figures, showing respect
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often filled with hesitation and uncertainty when vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses to indicate thoughtfulness or hesitation

worldview.value of friendship: demonstrates loyalty and a willingness to protect friends, often prioritizing their safety over his own
worldview.suspicion of authority: questions decisions made by authority figures, particularly when they seem unjust or harmful

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a loyal friend and brave companion
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often feels overshadowed by Harry and Hermione, leading to moments of insecurity
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or sarcastic when feeling inadequate or unappreciated

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm to deflect deeper emotions, maintaining a casual demeanor
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes stammered and fragmented, often repeating phrases or words
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements, avoiding elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks with confidence, using direct commands and assertive language

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially resorts to banter to mask fear, but may retreat if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm or questions their decisions directly
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes more assertive and protective, often raising his voice
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or make light of the situation rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, then frustration, leading to anger if his needs are not met

relationship_matrix.HARRY: close friend — seeks to support and protect him, often feeling overshadowed
relationship_matrix.HERMIONE: friend — admires her intelligence but feels insecure about his own abilities

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as brave and capable among friends
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often perceived as the comic relief or sidekick, leading to feelings of inadequacy
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between wanting to be a hero and often feeling like a supporting character
